root_cause: Evidence rows without a verified source were only recorded as VERIFIED_SOURCE_REQUIRED obligations and never received evaluated_at, so they stayed due forever. Netlify logs of revenue-learning-evaluate on 2026-10-27 18:00 to 2026-10-28 05:00 UTC show evaluated 0 on every hourly run with attempted 8 and unprocessedDue 103 constant (missingVerifiedSource plus insufficientCohort equal to 8 each run).
prevention: After the typed obligation is recorded, a row without a verified source is settled with markEvidenceEvaluated (it reopens only when its data changes, updated_at > evaluated_at). Cohort and metric gaps depend on other rows and are deliberately not settled. The run summary reports settledUnverified separately from evaluated.

evidence.runtime_status: unverified until protected merge, Netlify deploy and Netlify logs showing unprocessedDue falling; only effective together with the evidence timestamp guard (PR 5019) because a refreshed updated_at reopens settled rows

limitations: Depends on PR 5019 being applied first: without it the hourly projection refresh advances updated_at and reopens settled rows
Rows settled as unverified are not re-read when a source is added without changing the row
Insufficient-cohort rows still recirculate through the hourly rotation
